overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Commission cited the wrong executive session purpose (litigation rather than complaints against members) but was still entitled to meet in executive session to discuss the OML complaints.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission improperly entered executive session on Jan 4, 2012 to discuss two OML complaints, which the complainant said are not litigation.
allegations.key_passage: Although the Commission cited the wrong purpose for entering into executive session, it was legally entitled to discuss the Open Meeting Law complaints behind closed doors.
